evidenceBoundary: Public documentation is a behavioral reference only. This ledger does not copy source, prompts, private APIs, branding, assets, layouts, or trade dress.

capabilities.capability: One account can continue conversations on web, desktop, and mobile surfaces.
capabilities.reason: One conversation authority in the account, readable from every signed-in surface. A turn produced on the device while the account is unreachable waits in the open tab, marked, and uploads exactly once.

capabilities.capability: A user can choose response mode or effort and see which intelligence path answered.
capabilities.reason: OCADE exposes Automatic, Online, and Local-only intelligence instead of copying provider model branding.

capabilities.capability: Create and edit downloadable documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs, and code-backed files.
capabilities.reason: Artifact creation exists; durable lineage and all renderer/export paths are completed in Block 22.

capabilities.capability: Open generated output beside a conversation, revise it, recover from render errors, and export it.
capabilities.reason: OCADE adds originating-run lineage and offline access; the final storage migration remains in Block 22.

capabilities.capability: Projects group chats, knowledge, files, instructions, sharing, archive, and deletion.
capabilities.reason: OCADE Projects also own Code, Tasks, Artifacts, memory, permissions, and offline context after Block 20.

capabilities.capability: Project knowledge can be searched when it exceeds direct context capacity.
capabilities.reason: OCADE searches the account's own rows through parameterized filters, ranks them explainably, and adds scoped memory and explicit source age rather than copying provider RAG internals.

capabilities.capability: Share a point-in-time conversation snapshot and revoke it without exposing private attachment or tool data.
capabilities.reason: The share/revoke checkpoint implements a bounded snapshot and keeps attachment/tool internals private.

capabilities.capability: Chat and Cowork share one home and composer while changing execution mode.
capabilities.reason: The shared shell exists; final task, permit, and remote-executor composition remains in Block 18.

capabilities.capability: Long tasks show progress and can be steered, paused, stopped, resumed, or taken over.
capabilities.reason: OCADE adds explicit STOP, PAUSE, RESUME, TAKE OVER, receipts, and postcondition verification.

capabilities.capability: A complex task can coordinate parallel sub-agents while preserving one visible mission.
capabilities.reason: The agent and concurrency foundations exist; one-permit mission accounting remains in Blocks 8 and 18.

capabilities.capability: Prefer a connector or semantic browser/native tool before slower screen-coordinate interaction.
capabilities.reason: OCADE formalizes connector, DOM/accessibility, native semantics, vision, then guarded coordinates.

capabilities.capability: Computer control asks permission before accessing an application or destructive operation.
capabilities.reason: OCADE applies one policy authority across browser, native, shell, Git, file, and network actions.

capabilities.capability: Assign from mobile, execute through an awake paired desktop, and monitor or steer the same session.
capabilities.reason: The mobile and worker foundations exist; durable RemoteExecutor leases and recovery remain in Block 14.

capabilities.capability: The same task can be opened and steered from web, desktop, mobile, or the browser side panel.
capabilities.reason: Durable cross-surface state is retained as a parity target for Blocks 13, 14, 18, and 26.

capabilities.capability: Read and act in a user-approved Chrome context, including DOM, console, network, navigation, clicks, and typing.
capabilities.reason: The extension is real and tested; production context reacquisition and permission minimization remain in Block 24.

capabilities.capability: Read and edit a real repository, run commands, inspect diagnostics, and review exact changes.
capabilities.reason: OCADE already has immutable maps, hashes, patches, diagnostics, and undo; live Git/LSP/terminal wiring remains.

capabilities.capability: Run isolated repository tasks remotely, continue without supervision, and return a reviewable branch or pull request.
capabilities.reason: The portable contract can be completed locally; a configured repository host is required before advertising remote PR delivery.

capabilities.capability: Run multiple code tasks in isolated workspaces without cross-task state leakage.
capabilities.reason: Task isolation exists as a foundation; real repository-host and recovery proof remain in Blocks 14 and 19.

capabilities.capability: Close the build-test-verify loop in Chrome using DOM, console, and network evidence.
capabilities.reason: The packaged extension proves the primitives; Code-to-browser task composition remains in Block 19.

capabilities.capability: Skills, plugins, hooks, sub-agents, MCP-style tools, and LSP integrations extend Code workflows.
capabilities.reason: OCADE keeps one governed registry; invalid manifests, permission bypass, and failure isolation remain in Block 23.

capabilities.capability: Open, prefill, continue, or steer a Code session from mobile and hand it back to desktop.
capabilities.reason: Deep-link and mission-control foundations exist; final RemoteExecutor and platform proof remain.

capabilities.capability: Discover and manage skills, connectors, and plugins from one customization directory.
capabilities.reason: Customize is canonical; provider-backed connector availability and organization distribution remain in Blocks 23 and 27.

capabilities.capability: Enable personal and organization-provisioned skills and apply them automatically when relevant.
capabilities.reason: The governed skill authority exists; organization provisioning and revocation remain in Blocks 23 and 27.

capabilities.capability: Plugins bundle skills, connectors, hooks, and agents with scoped availability across Chat and Cowork.
capabilities.reason: OCADE does not create a second plugin system; capability scope and failure isolation remain in Block 23.

capabilities.capability: Invite, list, search, change role, deactivate, remove, and export organization members safely.
capabilities.reason: Core invitations and ownership safety are proven; groups, full export, deactivation, and role matrix remain in Block 27.

capabilities.capability: Custom roles and groups control product capabilities, connectors, and delegated administrative areas.
capabilities.reason: Server-enforced policy foundations exist; the complete custom-role/group UI and precedence proof remain in Block 27.

capabilities.capability: Administrators can authorize connectors centrally and scope access by group or role.
capabilities.reason: Policy and unavailable-state contracts are repository-controlled; each live connector still needs real credentials and revocation proof.

capabilities.capability: Administrators can enable browser control and apply site allowlists or blocklists.
capabilities.reason: OCADE adds origin, permission, injection, protected-field, and postcondition policies; organization UI proof remains.

capabilities.capability: Owners can distribute a curated plugin marketplace to an organization and control availability.
capabilities.reason: Marketplace and trust policy exist; organization distribution and revocation remain in Blocks 23 and 27.

capabilities.capability: Authorized administrators can inspect and export immutable organization audit events without exposing content by default.
capabilities.reason: OCADE already records administrative operations; complete tenant-wide audit coverage and export remain in Block 27.

capabilities.capability: Organization policy can separately govern Cowork, cloud execution, browsers, plugins, and local data boundaries.
capabilities.reason: OCADE additionally distinguishes local-only, online, offline leases, and RemoteExecutor access.
